name: aeromind
description: Neuro-symbolic disaster-response simulation and validation platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @aeromind/shared && npm run build --workspace @aeromind/server && npm run build --workspace @aeromind/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @aeromind/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @aeromind/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @aeromind/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @aeromind/shared && npm run test --workspace @aeromind/server
